claim: Field-wise validated-LLM application: anonymous activity-id reverse mapping, action-anchored local check re-execution, program-bound evidence/scope verification, and abstention when the program cannot confirm the claim. Offline constructed evidence only; no real API call.

llm_application_protocol.ambiguous_field: kept unknown; does not discard another resolved field
llm_application_protocol.action_grounding: anonymous id -> real id via pack map, then program re-check on that node
llm_application_protocol.condition_exception_positive_claims: require non-empty evidence ids inside the target action surface
llm_application_protocol.negative_absence_claims: accepted only when the program re-check closes the local scope
llm_application_protocol.constraint_claims: require programmatic numeric time comparison against the rule bound
llm_application_protocol.clear_deterministic_check: preserved and never overwritten by an LLM claim

candidate_pack.evidence_id_policy: advertised ids are derived from post-truncation visible evidence lists
candidate_pack.anonymisation_policy: only identifiers/generated tokens are mapped; natural-language text is verbatim
